bindings: Original frozen 57 live/capsule sources and 21 inputs checked; runtime-origin 41 sources plus validator capsules checked. Original input/model/port snapshots, new witness snapshot, raw split-state hash, fixture/all arrays/full CSC and candidate result rechecked through reference completion. controls.clock: STARTED precedes third-party imports; cooperative checkpoints cover saved data reads, evaluations, serialization and end-binding checks
